findings.title: Attempt-audit assertion does not verify ordering before destructive work
findings.scenario: Moving the attempt audit after the first credential deletion but before the second deletion fails would preserve the current assertions.
findings.expected: Verify a durable attempt record exists before the first destructive provider call.
findings.actual: The test queries the attempt record only after reset returns.
findings.evidence: Lines 95–99 check post-failure state; the provider double at lines 45–50 only records deletions. Production ordering is currently correct. Static coverage finding; container test NOT_RUN locally.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert target-specific audit persistence from the provider double before its first deletion, using an independent transaction.
findings.repro_test: A mutation moving the audit write after the first deletion should fail the strengthened test. Mutation NOT_RUN locally.
